text:
Ivy Nakamura: Heads-up everyone — we are GA-ing RouteFlow: the new adaptive routing mesh for hosted API today. RouteFlow centralizes routing rules, toolcall multiplexing, and cost-aware preferences into one console page (Console → Routing → RouteFlow). Rolling out region-by-region over the next 2 hours. :rocket:
Derek Shaw: nice! any customer-facing changes or required SDK bumps?
Ivy Nakamura: no mandatory SDK changes. Customers can opt into RouteFlow via header `X-Redwood-RouteFlow: 1` or by enabling a per-route policy in the Console. SDKs will add helpers in the next patch but will remain backwards compatible.
Priya Singh: runtime note — RouteFlow introduces multiplexed toolcalls (single request fanout to multiple tools) and a new streaming envelope for multi-tool partials. Eng-sre: please watch latency and chunk error rates.
eng-sre-bot: runbook and playbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/routeflow-ga. Alerts configured: if multiplexer error-rate >2% sustained 5m or stream-chunk-drop >1% for 10m, escalate. Canary keys: routeflow-canary-01..05. Auto-rollback policy active.
Liam O'Connor: billing impact? customers worried about hidden costs from multiplexing.
Ivy Nakamura: billing unchanged for standard usage. Multiplex bundles (when multiple tools are invoked in one request) are billed as separate tool calls and clearly labeled as "multiplex" in billing exports. We added a Console toggle to preview estimated multiplex costs per-route. Exported route traces (RouteFlowDump) are opt-in and billed under debug-exports.
docs-bot: docs published: https://docs.redwood.ai/routeflow (contains migration guide, policy JSON schema, and sample envelopes)
Derek Shaw: Dedicated/private details?
Ivy Nakamura: Dedicated: Admin → Feature Flags → RouteFlow to opt in cluster-wide; ops can restrict multiplexing families. Private/on-prem: included in the 2.2.0 bundle with a migration script — operators must run the policy-transform tool before enabling. See docs for the script link.
Priya Singh: deprecation: we will remove the legacy `route_hint` query param on 2026-12-01. Please use RouteFlow policies or the `X-Redwood-Prefer` header instead.
Liam O'Connor: quick pasteable curl example for eng channels?
Ivy Nakamura: sure:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/gen \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-RouteFlow: 1" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Prefer: cost" \
  -d '{"model":"mosaic-lite","route_policy":"routeflow-default","input":"Summarize the release notes"}'
```
marketing-bot: Product/Marketing will send an internal customer-ready email template and a public changelog entry. Please file any edge-cases to #product and tag marketing for case studies.
Ivy Nakamura: final: internal Q&A at 16:45 PT in #product. If you see regressions during rollout, ping @eng-sre and include the canary key. Thanks all — please don't flip the global toggle unless you're on the rollout team. :white_check_mark:
